content: May I kindly ask for a review of #39443? It adds a trivial Set-lemma that makes life a lot easier for #39445 (which is currently blocked by this).
(Note: My experience is that it is often faster to just include easy helper lemmas like this in the main PR.)

I disagree - I think it's easier in the review process to make easy helper lemmas like this and mark them easy, since then reviewers who aren't familiar with, eg Algebraic Geometry, can merge the helper PR
Pros and cons I guess. In this case I split it off since it had nothing to do with algebraic geometry. Maybe I should have marked it easy to attract reviewers :)
For some reason the toolchain bump to v4.31.0-rc1 deleted two lemmas which I've previously added, which means #39445 is blocked again (by PR #40189, which restores the deleted lemmas).
My guess is they were lost in some mis-resolved merge conflict; sorry for that.

More specifically, they seem to have been lost in this automated merge shortly after your original PR was merged. You can see them disappear (and be replaced by a set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in) when you run git diff 8d95dbc1f6..f8a230d2ef
Seems like the automated merge was resolved in favor of the nightly branch instead of master. I think it should've been resolved in favor of master, so maybe CI needs to be fixed.

@Damiano Testa maybe the declaration diff tools can be useful for this sort of thing too?

edit @Weiyi Wang had the same thought here https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/287929-mathlib4/topic/Declarations.20diff.20in.20Lean/near/599887107

@Weiyi Wang indeed, the declaration diff of that bump contains
- isoImage_ι_inv_morphismRestrict_homOfLE
- morphismRestrict_homOfLE_isoImage_ι_hom
Just to be clear, this is the current regex declaration diff, not the new one.

Joscha Mennicken said:

Seems like the automated merge was resolved in favor of the nightly branch instead of master. I think it should've been resolved in favor of master, so maybe CI needs to be fixed.

I've opened #40257 to swap the conflict resolution direction.
